title: Merge with engine-ab: a conflict resolution that keeps engine-ab's .llm branch sends the streamed LFM tiers to the full Hugging Face load
scenario: Running `git merge-tree` on lfm-moe-stream and engine-ab produces content conflicts in MLXBackend.load/loadLarge and in ModelCatalog.Entry. On engine-ab, `case .llm:` always calls `loadModelContainer(from: #hubDownloader(ModelStore.hub) ...)`, and `loadLarge` gains an `epoch:` parameter. On #10, `case .llm where target.streamed == nil` sends `lfm2.5-8b-a1b-stream75/62` (loader .llm) to `loadLarge`, which downloads the repacked build and calls `LLMModelFactory.loadContainer(from: streamedDirectory)`. If the conflict is resolved by taking engine-ab's switch, the streamed LFM entries download and load the full resident `LiquidAI/LFM2.5-8B-A1B-MLX-4bit` repo (4.85 GB). That repo has no experts.json, so `ExpertStreamRuntime.make` does not stream. The entries carry minimumMemoryGB 7 and residentGB 3.74, so the memory gate admits them, and the full load exceeds the ~5.3 GB app limit (jetsam). engine-ab's `Self.applyMemorySettings` hunk also replaces #10's greedy and exactPrefill handling.
evidence: `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/lfm-moe-stream origin/engine-ab` reports CONFLICT (content) in MLXBackend.swift and ModelCatalog.swift. The conflicting hunks are #10's `case .llm where target.streamed == nil: ... case .llm, .vlm: return try await loadLarge(target, progress:)` and engine-ab's `case .llm: let (configuration, local) = Self.storeConfiguration(for: target); let loaded = try await loadModelContainer(...)` and `private func loadLarge(_ target:, epoch loadEpoch: Int, progress:)`.
fix: When merging, keep #10's guard as `case .llm where target.streamed == nil:` in front of engine-ab's ModelStore body, and route `case .llm, .vlm:` to `loadLarge(target, epoch: loadEpoch, progress:)`. Inside loadLarge, keep the `if let streamedDirectory { switch target.loader { .llm: LLMModelFactory..., .vlm: VLMModelFactory... } } else { engine-ab store path }` split. Keep both `streamed` and `engine`/`xybridSource` in Entry, and add the greedy/exactPrefill lines after `applyMemorySettings`.
notes:
UPHELD(high): I confirmed the claim against the git sources. Running `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/lfm-moe-stream origin/engine-ab` gives CONFLICT (content) in ios/AgentConsole/Inference/MLXBackend.swift and ModelCatalog.swift. It also conflicts in .github/workflows/build.yml and docs/ENGINEERING-LOG.md.

Conflict block 1 in the merged MLXBackend.swift sits at about lines 239-284 of the merge tree:
- **lfm-moe-stream side:** sets Inkling2ExpertStreaming.options, then switches on the loader. `case .llm where target.streamed == nil:` goes to the HF load, and `case .llm, .vlm:` goes to `loadLarge(target, progress:)`.
- **engine-ab side:** has the `guard target.engine == .mlx` check. Its `case .llm:` always calls `loadModelContainer(from: #hubDownloader(ModelStore.hub) ...)` using `storeConfiguration(for: target)`, which is built from target.repo. Its `case .vlm:` goes to `loadLarge(target, epoch: loadEpoch, progress:)`, and the loadLarge signature gains `epoch loadEpoch: Int`.

ModelCatalog.lfm8bStreamed on lfm-moe-stream (lines 195-202) sets repo "LiquidAI/LFM2.5-8B-A1B-MLX-4bit", downloadGB 4.85, minimumMemoryGB 7, loader .llm and residentGB = core + fraction*experts (3.74 / 3.20 GB). The only thing that marks these entries as streamed is `e.streamed`.

So if the conflict is resolved by taking engine-ab's side, the stream75/62 tiers fall into `.llm`. That load fetches and fully loads the 4.85 GB resident repo, and the streaming options assignment is dropped too. The memory gate uses residentGB, so it would admit the load, and the full load would exceed the ~5.3 GB app limit. The result compiles fine, because the stale loadLarge body still references target.streamed, so the error would show up only at runtime.

The hazard is real and the scenario is accurate. Following the suggested fix avoids it: keep the `.llm where streamed == nil` guard with engine-ab's store body, route `.llm, .vlm` to `loadLarge(target, epoch:, progress:)`, keep the streaming options assignment, and keep both sets of Entry fields.

One caveat: this is a hazard in how the conflict gets resolved, not a defect on either branch alone. Medium severity is reasonable.

UPHELD(high): I confirmed the conflict. Running `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/lfm-moe-stream origin/engine-ab` (tree 8379183) reports CONFLICT (content) in ios/AgentConsole/Inference/MLXBackend.swift and ModelCatalog.swift, and also in build.yml and ENGINEERING-LOG.md. The hunks in MLXBackend match the claim exactly.

- **Load switch, lfm-moe-stream side:** `Inkling2ExpertStreaming.options = ...(enabled: target.streamed != nil ...)`, then `case .llm where target.streamed == nil: #huggingFaceLoadModelContainer(...)`, then `case .llm, .vlm: return try await loadLarge(target, progress:)`.
- **Load switch, engine-ab side:** `guard target.engine == .mlx`, then `case .llm:`, which always calls `loadModelContainer(from: #hubDownloader(ModelStore.hub) ...)` with `Self.storeConfiguration(for: target)`, then `case .vlm: loadLarge(target, epoch: loadEpoch, progress:)`.
- **Second hunk (loadLarge body):** lfm-moe-stream's `if let streamedDirectory { switch .llm: LLMModelFactory... / .vlm: VLMModelFactory... } else {...}` plus the streaming report line, against engine-ab's store-only `VLMModelFactory.shared.loadContainer(from: #hubDownloader(ModelStore.hub)...)` with an `isCurrent(loadEpoch)` guard.
- **Third hunk (memory settings):** lfm-moe-stream's greedy temperature and exactPrefill stepSize override, against engine-ab's `params.temperature = current.temperature; Self.applyMemorySettings(of:to:)`.

ModelCatalog on lfm-moe-stream defines `lfm25_8b_a1b_stream75` and `lfm25_8b_a1b_stream62` through `lfm8bStreamed` with these values: `repo: "LiquidAI/LFM2.5-8B-A1B-MLX-4bit"`, `downloadGB: 4.85`, `minimumMemoryGB: 7`, `loader: .llm`, and `residentGB` = core + fraction * experts. If the conflict is resolved with engine-ab's side, these `.llm` entries go to the plain full-repo store load. Streaming is never enabled, because the `Inkling2ExpertStreaming.options` assignment is also inside the lfm hunk and gets dropped. The app then loads the resident 4.85 GB 4-bit build, while the catalog advertised a smaller streamed footprint, so the jetsam risk against the ~5.3 GB limit is real. The greedy and exactPrefill diagnostics are lost as well.

Neither branch is merged into origin/integration yet; each is only contained in its own ref. This is a genuine merge hazard that requires a manual three-way resolution, not a defect on either branch alone. The proposed fix is consistent with both sides: keep the `streamed == nil` guard plus `ModelStore`, thread `epoch:` into `loadLarge`, keep the streamed-directory split, and re-add the greedy and exactPrefill lines after `applyMemorySettings`. Medium severity is reasonable.

title: Merge with inkling-lamq: the conflict over `ModelCatalog.all` can silently drop lfmStreamTiers
scenario: inkling-stream (#9) alone merges cleanly with inkling-lamq in ModelCatalog. #10 rewrites the `static let all` line (`+ lfmStreamTiers + inklingTiers`), and inkling-lamq appends its LamqBuild block right above the old `all` line, so lfm-moe-stream x inkling-lamq now conflicts there (lines 115-271 of the merged file). Taking the inkling-lamq side, which ends with `static let all: [Entry] = [...] + inklingTiers`, compiles but removes both LFM streamed tiers from the picker without any error.
evidence: `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/lfm-moe-stream origin/inkling-lamq` reports CONFLICT (content) in ModelCatalog.swift. Ours: `static let all: [Entry] = [lfm3_1_7b, lfm25_1_2b, lfm25_350m, lfm25_8b_a1b, qwen3_1_7b]\n        + lfmStreamTiers + inklingTiers`. Theirs: LamqBuild/lamq39/47/54 followed by `static let all: [Entry] = [lfm3_1_7b, ...] + inklingTiers`. The same pairing (inkling-stream x inkling-lamq) does not conflict in this file.
fix: Resolve as a union: keep the StreamedBuild/Inkling/LFM streamed blocks and the LamqBuild block, and a single `static let all: [Entry] = [lfm3_1_7b, lfm25_1_2b, lfm25_350m, lfm25_8b_a1b, qwen3_1_7b] + lfmStreamTiers + inklingTiers` (lamq builds stay out of `all`, as that branch intends).
notes: UPHELD(high): I could not refute the claim. Running `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/lfm-moe-stream origin/inkling-lamq` reports CONFLICT (content) in ios/AgentConsole/Inference/ModelCatalog.swift. In the merged file the hunk runs from line 115 (<<<<<<< origin/lfm-moe-stream) to line 271 (>>>>>>> origin/inkling-lamq). The lfm-moe-stream side holds the LFM streamed-tier block: lfm25_8b_a1b_stream75/62 at lines 207/212, lfmStreamTiers at line 216, and `static let all = [...] + lfmStreamTiers + inklingTiers` at lines 218-219. The inkling-lamq side ends with `static let all: [Entry] = [...] + inklingTiers` at line 270. Merging inkling-stream with inkling-lamq gives only "Auto-merging" for ModelCatalog.swift, with no conflict, which matches the claim. `git grep` on origin/lfm-moe-stream finds no reference to lfmStreamTiers, stream75/stream62 or lfm8bStreamed outside ModelCatalog.swift. So resolving the hunk with "theirs" still compiles and quietly drops the streamed LFM tiers, and nothing else in the code would fail to show it. The conflict markers themselves are visible, so the hazard is only a wrong resolution choice, and low severity is right. The proposed union resolution is the correct fix.

UPHELD(high): I confirmed the conflict. `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/lfm-moe-stream origin/inkling-lamq` reports a content conflict in ios/AgentConsole/Inference/ModelCatalog.swift. In the merged blob, the conflict markers run from line 115 to line 271. The ours side (lfm-moe-stream) defines `static let lfmStreamTiers` at line 216, and `static let all = [...] + lfmStreamTiers + inklingTiers` at lines 218-219. The theirs side (inkling-lamq) holds the LamqBuild struct, lamq39/47/54 and lamqBuilds (lines 227-268), then `static let all = [...] + inklingTiers` at line 270. The inkling-stream x inkling-lamq merge-tree does not list ModelCatalog.swift as conflicted, which matches the claim. Resolving by taking theirs drops lfmStreamTiers from `all`, so the LFM streamed tiers disappear from the picker without any error. Taking theirs wholesale for the whole hunk would also drop the other definitions on the ours side. Whether the result then compiles depends on where inklingTiers is defined, but either way it is a real merge hazard. Low severity is appropriate. The proposed union resolution is correct.

title: VENDORED.md not updated: patch C still described as the MLXVLM Inkling2ExpertStreaming.swift, and the LFM2MoE.swift patch is not listed
scenario: #10 moves the streaming core to the new MLXLMCommon/ExpertStreaming.swift and ExpertStreaming+SwitchGLU.swift, turns MLXVLM/Models/Inkling2ExpertStreaming.swift into a typealias shim, and patches MLXLLM/Models/LFM2MoE.swift (prepareCheckpoint plus a CheckpointLoadingHooks conformance). VENDORED.md is unchanged from #9 (`git diff origin/inkling-stream origin/lfm-moe-stream` does not touch it). It still says Inkling2ExpertStreaming.swift holds the manifest, reader and slot cache, and it does not list LFM2MoE.swift or the two new MLXLMCommon files. The 'Updating' procedure ('re-copy ... re-apply the patches') would therefore drop the LFM2MoE patch and the new MLXLMCommon files on the next re-vendor. The result would be a compile failure: Inkling2ExpertStreaming.swift typealiases would point at missing types. VENDORED.md also conflicts textually with inkling-kernels.
evidence: VENDORED.md on lfm-moe-stream, item 4: "`Libraries/MLXVLM/Models/Inkling2ExpertStreaming.swift` (new): the `experts.json` manifest, an `F_NOCACHE` `preadv` reader, the per-layer `Inkling2ExpertSlotCache`...". It has no mention of LFM2MoE.swift or MLXLMCommon/ExpertStreaming*.swift. `git diff --stat origin/inkling-stream origin/lfm-moe-stream` does not include VENDORED.md.
fix: Update item 4: (a) list MLXLMCommon/ExpertStreaming.swift and ExpertStreaming+SwitchGLU.swift as the new home of the manifest, reader, slot cache, StreamedSwitchGLU and installStreamedSwitchGLU; (b) describe Inkling2ExpertStreaming.swift as a typealias shim; (c) add MLXLLM/Models/LFM2MoE.swift (installExpertStreaming in prepareCheckpoint plus the CheckpointLoadingHooks extension). Merge with inkling-kernels' VENDORED.md edit by keeping both items.
notes: UPHELD(high): I could not refute this; it is confirmed. `git diff origin/inkling-stream origin/lfm-moe-stream -- ios/Vendor/mlx-swift-lm/VENDORED.md` is empty, and the `--stat` output for that range does not list VENDORED.md. On lfm-moe-stream, VENDORED.md item 4 still says `Libraries/MLXVLM/Models/Inkling2ExpertStreaming.swift` holds the experts.json manifest, the F_NOCACHE preadv reader and the Inkling2ExpertSlotCache. The file on that branch is now only a typealias shim: `Inkling2ExpertStreaming = ExpertStreaming`, `Inkling2ExpertSlotCache = ExpertSlotCache`, and so on, all pointing at the new MLXLMCommon/ExpertStreaming.swift. The branch also adds MLXLMCommon/ExpertStreaming.swift (925 lines) and ExpertStreaming+SwitchGLU.swift (89 lines). It patches MLXLLM/Models/LFM2MoE.swift: it adds an `expertStreaming` property and calls `installExpertStreaming` from `prepareCheckpoint`, marked `[agent-console patch C]`. VENDORED.md mentions none of these three files. So the doc is stale, and a re-vendor that follows its "Updating" steps would miss the LFM2MoE patch and the new MLXLMCommon files. That would leave the shim's typealiases unresolved, a compile failure. This is a documentation and merge hazard, not a build break on the branch as it stands, so low severity fits. The fix is to update item 4 as described and keep both items when merging with the inkling-kernels edit to the same file.

UPHELD(high): Confirmed with git, low severity. In `C:\Users\apumu\research\CHLabs\mlx-agent-console`, `git diff --stat origin/inkling-stream origin/lfm-moe-stream` changes 11 files and VENDORED.md is not one of them. That diff includes `MLXLLM/Models/LFM2MoE.swift` (+69), new `MLXLMCommon/ExpertStreaming.swift` (+925) and `ExpertStreaming+SwitchGLU.swift` (+89), and `MLXVLM/Models/Inkling2ExpertStreaming.swift` shrinking to a 15-line shim (-919).

VENDORED.md on origin/lfm-moe-stream, lines 24-35 (item 4), still says `Libraries/MLXVLM/Models/Inkling2ExpertStreaming.swift` (new) holds the manifest, the preadv reader and `Inkling2ExpertSlotCache`. `git grep` finds no mention of LFM2MoE or the MLXLMCommon/ExpertStreaming files anywhere in VENDORED.md.

The new code does carry markers, so it is a real undocumented local patch. LFM2MoE.swift:526, :581 and :692 and ExpertStreaming.swift:1 are all marked `[agent-console patch C]`. ExpertStreaming.swift:1 even says the streaming is "for mixture-of-experts models (Inkling 2, LFM2 MoE)", while VENDORED.md describes patch C as Inkling-only.

The merge hazard is also real. origin/inkling-kernels replaces the line "Both code patches are marked `[agent-console patch A/B]`" with a new K1/K2 section. inkling-stream/lfm-moe-stream changes that same line to "The code patches are marked A/B/C" and inserts item 4 just above it, so the two edits overlap and will conflict textually.

One caveat: the claimed compile failure is an overstatement. It only happens on a future manual re-vendor that follows the stale doc, not in the current build. So the defect is a stale doc plus a merge conflict, and low severity is right. The suggested fix is correct: rewrite item 4 to list the MLXLMCommon ExpertStreaming files, the Inkling2ExpertStreaming typealias shim and the LFM2MoE.swift patch, and keep both the item-4 and K-section edits when merging.
